WorkSync 0.4.1 adds rich formatting for long text, makes task priority
visible, and fixes layout problems in the new screens.

## Download

| System                    | File                              |
| ------------------------- | --------------------------------- |
| Windows (64-bit)          | `WorkSync-win32-x64-0.4.1.zip`    |
| macOS (Apple silicon)     | `WorkSync-darwin-arm64-0.4.1.zip` |
| Linux (no install)        | `WorkSync-linux-x64-0.4.1.zip`    |
| Linux, Debian or Ubuntu   | `worksync_0.4.1_amd64.deb`        |
| Linux, Fedora or openSUSE | `worksync-0.4.1-1.x86_64.rpm`     |

- **Windows:** unzip into a folder on a local drive and run `worksync.exe`.
  Nothing is installed. To update, unzip the new version in the same place as
  the old one: your data is in the `WorkSync-data` folder next to it and stays.
- **macOS:** unzip and move `WorkSync.app` to Applications.
- **Linux:** unzip and run `worksync`, or install the package.

The builds aren't code signed yet, so Windows and macOS warn the first time.
See [Download and run](https://github.com/KelvinNguyen97/WorkSync#download-and-run)
for how to open the app anyway. Your data from 0.4.0 is kept as it is.

## New

- **Rich formatting for long text.** A formatting bar on the text box, and
  the saved text shown formatted: headings, bold, italic, strikethrough,
  code, bullet, numbered and check lists, quotes and links.
  - For a ticket's summary and notes, discussion descriptions and comments,
    a project task's note, and a My tasks description.
  - Ctrl+B and Ctrl+I work, lists continue when you press Enter, and
    **Preview** shows the result before you save.
  - The text is kept as typed, in Markdown style (`**bold**`, `- item`).
    Text without marks looks as before.
  - Reports, briefs and the published page get the text without the marks;
    lists keep their bullets and numbers.
  - The customer's own text is left exactly as it is in their file.
- **Tasks show their priority.** Urgent tasks are tinted red with a tag and
  Low ones are dimmed, like ticket cards. This applies to project tasks and
  to My tasks.
- **Adding a project task** has a date box and a priority list beside the
  line. Both are optional, and a date typed in the line still works.

## Fixed

- The ticket summary was shown as one paragraph; it now keeps its line
  breaks and formatting.
- A request to join a workspace was drawn over the page on My tasks, Notes
  and Catalog. It now has its own row above the page.
- A late task's date wrapped onto two lines in Japanese.
- The Number clash tag was squeezed under the ticket number.
- In a narrow window, Notices and Workspaces opened with the sidebar still
  open underneath.
- The ticket window's flags, such as "Brief incomplete", showed in English
  on Japanese screens.

Please report problems on the
[Issues page](https://github.com/KelvinNguyen97/WorkSync/issues).
